items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Dolores Mancuso says you were a great impressionist.

ctx.x: Oh man, how about that guy? And not a lot of chops. And another thing about him was he would be on a jingle or something. And a lot of jingle writers, they write out everything. And he was a natural player. And he — of course you don’t ever want to give the impression that you don’t know how to read you know in a situation like that. And Gordon would look at the part, “Oh yeah, yeah man, oh yeah.” I mean he’d act like he was reading but he couldn’t read that much. But he played the shit out of it. He played the…
Dolores Mancuso says you were a great impressionist.
